1. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener, comprising: first, second and third members formed from laminated composite tape, the first and second members defining a web and flanges extending from the web, the third member being joined to the flanges and extending generally transverse to the web, the first, second and third composite members intersecting to form a void; a filler disposed in and substantially filling the void; at least one layer of composite fabric on each of the members in the area of the filler; and, a layer of __structural__ adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric.

2. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the first and second members include radius areas between the web and each of the flanges, and the fabric layer covers the radius areas __and wherein the layer of structural adhesive includes a folded sheet of structural adhesive__.

3. (Original) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the layer of adhesive includes a folded sheet of structural adhesive.

4. (Original) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the at least one layer of composite fabric includes graphite fibers held in an epoxy matrix.

5. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the layer of __structural__ adhesive and the at least one layer of composite fabric extend beyond the radius areas.

6. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the at least one layer of composite fabric of the composite members are offset relative to each other __and wherein the offset is configured to avoid wrinkles in the composite fabric__.

7. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener, comprising: a pair of composite channels joined together, each of the channels including a web, flanges extending from the web, and radius areas between the web and each of the flanges; a base extending transverse to the web and joined to each of the flanges, the radius areas of the channels and the base forming at least one radius filler zone; a reinforcing member filling the radius filler zone; a layer of composite fabric covering the radius areas of the channels and the base; and, a layer of __structural__ adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric layer.

8. (Original) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the each of the composite channels and the base includes laminated reinforcing fibers.

9. (Original) The composite stiffener of claim 8, wherein the composite fabric layer includes woven bidirectional reinforcing fibers.

10. (Original) The composite stiffener of claim 9, wherein the bidirectional reinforcing fibers are graphite.

11. (Original) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the filler is one of: a formed unidirectional composite tape, a composite laminate, a hybrid tape-fabric member, __and__ a titanium member.

12. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the composite fabric layer includes three composite patches respectively on each of the channels and the base __and wherein the patches are positioned to provide reinforcement at predetermined stress concentration areas__.

13. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the layer of __structural__ adhesive includes a sheet of structural adhesive wrapped around the filler __and wherein the layer of structural adhesive extends beyond the radius filler zone into interfacial layers between the channels and between the base and each of the flanges__.

14. (Original) The composite stiffener of claim 13, wherein the layer of adhesive extends beyond the radius filler zone into interfacial layers between the channels and between the base and each of the flanges.

15. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, __wherein__ the channels are __C-shaped in cross-section and are oriented to face each other__.

16. (Original) A method of fabricating a composite stiffener, comprising: forming a pair of composite channels each having a flange and a radius portion, using composite fiber tape; placing a layer of composite fiber fabric over the radius portion of each of the channels; forming a base using composite fiber tape; placing a layer of composite fiber fabric over at least a portion of the base; placing a layer of adhesive around a filler; placing the filler in a radius filler zone between the radius portions of the channels and the base; and, curing the assembly.

17. (Original) The method of claim 16, wherein the forming of the composite channels and the base includes laying up unidirectional reinforcing fibers.

18. (Original) The method of claim 16, wherein placing the adhesive includes wrapping the filler with a sheet of adhesive.

19. (Original) The method of claim 16, further comprising: placing layers of composite fiber fabric on sections of each of the C-channels, the base and the cap outside the radius filler zone; and, introducing a layer of adhesive between the layers of composite fiber fabric on the sections outside the radius filler zone.

20. (Original) A method of fabricating a reinforced composite stiffener, comprising: forming a composite structure having a web and a pair of flanges extending in opposite directions from the web, applying a layer of composite fabric over laminated composite tape plies in an area between the web and the flanges; joining a surface of the cap to the flanges; applying a layer of composite fabric to the surface of the cap joined to the flanges; placing a reinforcing filler between the web, the flanges and the cap; and, using an adhesive to join the reinforcing filler to the composite fabric layers on the composite structure and the cap.

21. (Original) The method of claim 20, wherein: forming the composite structure includes forming the laminated tape plies into first and second channels, and applying a layer of composite fabric over the laminated composite tape plies includes placing patches of the composite fabric on selected areas of the first and second channels.

22. (Original) The method of claim 21, further comprising: placing a layer of composite fabric on facing surfaces of the each of the first and second channels; introducing an adhesive between the layers of composite fabric on the facing surfaces of the first and second channels; and, joining the first and second channels together at the facing surfaces.

23. (Original) The method of claim 20, wherein using an adhesive to join the reinforcing filler to the composite fabric layers includes wrapping a layer of structural adhesive around the filler.

24. (Original) A method of fabricating a reinforced composite stiffener for aircraft applications, comprising: forming multi-ply lay-ups of unidirectional composite tape; forming the lay-ups into first and second C-channels, a cap and a base; assembling the C-channels, the cap and the base into an I-section structure having a web and a pair of flanges on each end of the web; applying composite fabric to surfaces of the C-channels, the cap and the base in areas forming radius filler zones at the intersection of the web with the cap and with the base; wrapping a reinforcing filler with a structural adhesive; placing the reinforcing filler and the adhesive in the radius filler zone; and curing the assembly.

25. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener for aircraft applications, comprising: an I-section structure formed of laminated composite __tape plies and having__ a web and __first and second sets of__ flanges on each end of the web, the structure including a __pair of C-shaped channels, each channel__ including radius areas between the web and the flanges and __wherein__ a cap __is__ joined to the first set of the flanges and the base being joined to the second set of flanges, the cap and the base each intersecting the web in the radius areas to define a radius filler zone; __a layer of composite fabric on the I-section structure defining the radius filler zone;__ a reinforcing filler in the radius filler zone; and __a layer of structural adhesive surrounding__ the filler to the composite fabric in the radius filler zone.
